Title: Modulation of protective reflex cough by acute immune driven inflammation of lower airways in anesthetized rabbits
Abstract: To test the efficiency of sensitization a dermal test was realized and as far as possible, @SPECIES_9986 @@@rabbits@@@ with smallest indurations were intended to control group i.e. not exposed to OVA <m>aerosols</m> (S1 Fig and S1 Table). As the use of OVA <m>aerosol</m> leads to the development of an antigen tolerance and the quick resolution of @DISEASE_Inflammation @DISEASE_MESH:D007249 @@@<m>inflammation</m>@@@ after discontinuing antigen exposures we realized preliminary experiments to determine the optimal <m>aerosol</m> <m>challenge</m> number that allowed us to <m>reproduce</m> some key features of clinical acute @DISEASE_Asthma @DISEASE_MESH:D001249 @@@asthma@@@, such as early and late-phase <m>bronchoconstriction</m> in response to allergen <m>challenge</m> and the influx of eosinophils into lower respiratory tract resulting in eosinophil @DISEASE_Inflammation @DISEASE_MESH:D007249 @@@<m>airway</m> <m>inflammation</m>@@@.
